projects.title: Dynamic Memory Allocator
projects.description:
Designed and implemented my own version of the dynamic Memory Allocator (Malloc library) provided by C stdlib.  Through the use of explicit free list, segregated free lists and different fit algorithms (best fit, first fit and next fit), I was able to achieve a 75.5% memory utilization, given the overhead of maintain additional information about heap and other data structures. The memory utilization was achieved at a trade-off for number of Kilo-operations per second (Kops) i.e number of memory operations done per second.
My implementation of the malloc library was ranked in the top 10 submissions (taking into account, utilization vs speed) made during the Fall 2017

projects.title: Linux Shell (Shell Lab)
projects.description:
• Implemented a simple linux shell that can run programs on behalf of the user.
• Supports job control and IO redirection.
• Issues addressed include avoiding race conditions, effective reaping of child processes, etc.
